description: This file contains classes and functions related to subgraph autotuning, including subgraph inlining, generating subgraph choices for autotuning, layout inference for custom ops, and benchmarking. It is part of the torch._inductor.codegen module, specifically for subgraph code generation and autotuning within PyTorch's compiler infrastructure.

classes.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller
classes.description: Represents a subgraph autotuning choice, capable of compiling, benchmarking, and managing subgraph inputs and layouts.

classes.name: SubgraphTemplate
classes.description: A template class for creating subgraph choices for autotuning, supporting custom op decomposition and layout inference.

methods.name: inline_subgraph_to_ir_nodes
methods.description: Converts a torch.fx.GraphModule subgraph into IR nodes, enabling fusion and optimization.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a subgraph choice for autotuning, setting up example inputs, symbolic inputs, and compilation cache.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller._compute_sym_input_values
methods.description: Computes concrete values for symbolic input dimensions based on example inputs.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.cache_decomposition
methods.description: Caches a decomposition function and its arguments for range-based dispatch.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller._compile_for_benchmarking
methods.description: Compiles the subgraph into a module suitable for benchmarking.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.benchmark
methods.description: Runs benchmarking on the compiled subgraph module with provided inputs.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.benchmark_collective
methods.description: Runs a collective benchmark on the subgraph module.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.hash_key
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for the subgraph choice based on its configuration.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.output_node
methods.description: Returns the IR tensor node representing the subgraph's output.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.info_dict
methods.description: Provides info about the subgraph choice for logging purposes.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.autoheuristic_id
methods.description: Returns an ID string for heuristic-based autotuning.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate.generate
methods.description: Creates a SubgraphChoiceCaller instance for a specific subgraph configuration.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate.generate_custom_op_choices
methods.description: Generates multiple subgraph choices for custom operator decomposition autotuning.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._generate_variant_name
methods.description: Creates a descriptive name for a decomposition variant with its parameters.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._validate_non_tensor_kwargs
methods.description: Ensures that kwargs contain only non-tensor arguments.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._validate_layout_equivalence
methods.description: Checks that all layouts have consistent stride, device, dtype, and size for fair comparison.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._infer_custom_op_layout
methods.description: Infers output layout for custom ops using default implementation and example inputs.
